characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a rough‑spun wool tunic in brown with coarse texture and visible scuffs from daily work. Over the tunic she dons a dark‑brown leather apron that is worn and scuffed. She completes her outfit with sturdy leather boots, simple woolen trousers beneath the tunic, and a plain knitted cap to keep hair out of the way
characters.action: wipes a polished table with a cloth soaked in ale-scented oil

characters.name: Goblin
characters.clothing: Goblin: - Tunic (rough‑spun wool, dark green, stiff texture, scuffed from daily use) - Breeches (brown leather, smooth with worn patches) - Boots (black leather, rubbery sole, scuffed at the toes) - Belt (woven brown leather across waist)

characters.name: Elf
characters.clothing: female elf (age 150) wearing a long emerald‑green linen tunic with delicate silver thread embroidery along the cuffs and hem; fitted dark brown linen breeches tucked into leather ankle boots dyed deep amber; a lightweight woolen cloak in midnight blue draped over her shoulders, fastened at the neck by a simple silver brooch; she carries a small leather pouch on a waist belt. Hair is long silver flowing down to her shoulders
characters.action: takes a seat at the back table

characters.name: Dragon
characters.action: slides onto a high bar stool, licks its lips and sips the brew
